rationale: Builds on the best 9x512 reverse recurrent-tail branch. The embedded training script adds tail_anchor_gates, initialized at zero so the initial path matches the decoder-output anchor baseline, then learns per-channel mixing toward each tail block first-pass decoder output. This is a cheap recurrence/carry edit that preserves the data path, MAX_WALLCLOCK_SECONDS behavior, and final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact evaluation.
title: Learned Local Anchor Gate For Reverse Tail Recurrence
